sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned Counsel for the opposite party no.2, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for the following main relief:-
"It is therefore most humbly and respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow this petition under 482 Cr.P.C. being filed for quashing of Karam Veer Singh (As Per Fir Karam Veer ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158042210/
1 chargsheet on dated 03.02.2021 including order dated 14.10.2022 taking cognizance and summoning order passed by A.C.J.M. Room no. 28 Lucknow, (Presently this case pending before Court A.C.J.M. 2 Room no. 26 Lucknow) in case State Versus Karam Veer Singh and others arising out of case no. 91806 / 2022 Crime No.: 467 / 2020 U/S 498A,506,507,323, 504, I.P.C And 3/4 D.P. Act P.S. Indiranagar District Lucknow. contained in Annexure no. 1 to this petition."
Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that both the parties have amicably settled their dispute outside the Court and have entered into a compromise.

entities.text: State Versus Karam Veer Singh and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: D.P. Act P.S. Indiranagar District Lucknow
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As such, keeping in view the settlement arrived at between the parties and the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in this regard, the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.

Whether the parties have, in fact, compromised the matter or not, can best be ascertained by the Trial Court as such compromise has to be duly verified in presence of the parties concerned before the Court.

Considering the aforesaid, the instant application is disposed of finally in following terms:-
(i) The parties to the proceedings i.e. Case No.91806 / 2022 (State Versus Karam Veer Singh and others ) (supra), shall appear before the concerned Court within two week's from today and file the compromise.
(ii) If the parties appear before the concerned Court in terms of above, the concerned Court shall proceed to verify the compromise between the parties to the proceedings and prepare a report to the same effect and the original compromise deed be made part of record.

entities.text: Case No.91806 / 2022 (State Versus Karam Veer Singh and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (iii) The concerned Court shall conclude the process of verification of compromise within two week's from the date of production of copy of this order.
(iv) The concerned Court shall permit the parties to the proceedings to obtain the certified copy of the report as well as compromise deed.
(v) It shall be open to the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
(vi) For a period of six weeks, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.

As such, keeping in view the settlement arrived at between the parties and the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in this regard, the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.
Whether the parties have, in fact, compromised the matter or not, can best be ascertained by the Trial Court as such compromise has to be duly verified in presence of the parties concerned before the Court.

Considering the aforesaid, the instant application is disposed of finally in following terms:-
(i) The parties to the proceedings i.e. Case No.91806 / 2022 (State Versus Karam Veer Singh and others ) (supra), shall appear before the concerned Court within two week's from today and file the compromise.
(ii) If the parties appear before the concerned Court in terms of above, the concerned Court shall proceed to verify the compromise between the parties to the proceedings and prepare a report to the same effect and the original compromise deed be made part of record.
(iii) The concerned Court shall conclude the process of verification of compromise within two week's from the date of production of copy of this order.
(iv) The concerned Court shall permit the parties to the proceedings to obtain the certified copy of the report as well as compromise deed.
